genesis_block.label: Genesis Block

milestone.help: A block presumed to be valid but not required to be present.

minimum_work.label: Minimum Work
minimum_work.help: The minimum work for any branch to be considered valid.

forks.title: Forks
forks.summary: The consensus rules enforced. The defaults are mainnet.

bip113.label: BIP113
bip113.help: Use median time past for locktime (soft fork).

bip30.label: BIP30
bip30.help: Disallow collision of unspent transaction hashes (soft fork).

bip34.label: BIP34
bip34.help: Require coinbase input includes block height (soft fork).

bip54_coinbase.label: BIP54 Coinbase
bip54_coinbase.help: Require coinbase locktime of parent height and non-final sequence (soft fork).

bip54_sigops.label: BIP54 Sigops
bip54_sigops.help: Limit legacy signature operations per transaction (soft fork).

bip54_timewarp.label: BIP54 Timewarp
bip54_timewarp.help: Limit timestamp regression on retarget blocks (soft fork).

bip90.label: BIP90
bip90.help: Freeze BIP34, BIP65, and BIP66 activation at the BIP90 heights (hard fork).

difficult.label: Difficult
difficult.help: Require difficult blocks (use false for testnet).

ltc_retarget_overflow_patch.label: LTC Retarget Overflow Patch
ltc_retarget_overflow_patch.help: Fix target overflow for very low difficulty (litecoin).

ltc_scrypt_proof_of_work.label: LTC Scrypt Proof Of Work
ltc_scrypt_proof_of_work.help: Use scrypt hashing for proof of work (litecoin).

hd_public_prefix.label: HD Public Prefix

wif_prefix.label: WIF Prefix

witness_prefix.label: Witness Prefix
witness_prefix.help: The witness address prefix (use 'tb' for testnet).
